## The problem

Once a model of the expected behavior is available, comparing it with the observed behavior
reveals deviations. Detecting them is only the first step: they must be characterized. Is it a
fault or a cyber-attack? A sudden change, such as a fall or a short illness, or a slow drift
caused by a degenerative disease or by frailty? A real anomaly, or a digital twin that no
longer fits its system and must be updated?

In critical systems, good detection performance is not enough: decisions must be justified
and deviations explained to the operator or to the medical staff. Explainability is therefore
part of the characterization: interpretable discrete-event models keep this understanding
while learning from data, and help explain the results of the AI methods used, so that they
remain understandable. Characterized deviations also drive maintenance: corrective, but also
predictive and preventive, thanks to a digital twin that can simulate and predict the
behavior of its system.

## Contributions

- **Diagnosis of cyber-attacks in cyber-physical systems.** Diagnosers built from labeled
  Petri nets to detect attacks between a process and its controller; timed deviation patterns,
  observed through residuals, to tell attacks from faults.
- **Deviation detection by adaptive modeling.** A software prototype that builds and updates
  the behavioral digital twin of a production line from its sensor and actuator signals, to
  detect faults and cyber-attacks early, in a form operators can interpret (ADAM project).
- **Behavioral deviations of frail people at home.** Detection of deviations from the
  requirements set by medical staff; life habits — activity durations and ordering — modeled
  by stochastic timed automata to detect anomalies; forecasting of activity durations to
  detect slow, long-term changes early and inform the medical staff.
- **Home monitoring.** Algorithms developed in the 5P project, industrialised by ENGIE Ineo
  Digital in its Smartflat product; remote patient monitoring with Wi-Fi sensing, with the
  start-up [Zoe Care](https://zoe.care/) (WiFine RPM project).
- **Explainability of deviations** (ongoing work). Explaining the deviations that have been
  detected, in particular with AI methods, and turning these explanations into messages that
  the operator or the medical staff can understand.

**Perspective** — assessing the mental workload of a human through a human digital twin
(dashed box in the figure).

## Selected publications

- [Cyber-Attacks Diagnosis in Discrete Event Systems using Timed Deviation Pattern Recognition](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ifacol.2025.09.346) — *IFAC MIM*, 2025. [Industrial & critical systems]{.domain-tag .domain-industry}\
  [Models a system prone to both faults and attacks as a nominal and a faulty timed automaton; an observer follows chains of deviations, expressed through residuals, to tell attacks from faults.]{.contribution}
- [Construction of Model-based Diagnosis of Cyber-Attack in Cyber-Physical Systems Using Labeled Petri Nets](https://hal.science/hal-04213244) — *IEEE ETFA*, 2023. [PDF](https://hal.science/hal-04213244/document){.pdf-link} [Industrial & critical systems]{.domain-tag .domain-industry}\
  [Builds a diagnosis model from labeled Petri nets to detect attacks between a process and its controller before they destabilize the system.]{.contribution}
- [Long-term deviation detection in human behavior](https://doi.org/10.1109/CASE49439.2021.9551594) — *IEEE CASE*, 2021. [PDF](https://hal.science/hal-04160204/document){.pdf-link} [Human & health]{.domain-tag .domain-human}\
  [Forecasts activity durations to detect early the slow behavior changes caused by degenerative diseases, and informs the medical staff.]{.contribution}
- [Model-Based Approach for Anomaly Detection in Smart Home Inhabitant Daily Life](https://hal.science/hal-04160196) — *ACC*, 2021. [PDF](https://hal.science/hal-04160196/document){.pdf-link} [Human & health]{.domain-tag .domain-human}\
  [Models life habits — activity durations and ordering — with stochastic timed automata, to detect behavioral changes that may be symptoms of health problems.]{.contribution}
- [Activity Discovery and Detection of Behavioral Deviations of an Inhabitant From Binary Sensors](https://hal.science/hal-01253810) — *IEEE T-ASE*, 2015. [PDF](https://hal.science/hal-01253810/document){.pdf-link} [Human & health]{.domain-tag .domain-human}\
  [Discovers the activities of a smart-home inhabitant by sequence mining on binary sensor events, models them as automata, and detects deviations from the requirements set by medical staff.]{.contribution}
